title: Same-TL Armor Regeneration and Crystalline Rebaseline Diagnostic
energyDoctrine: SafeOverloadFirst until Energy Strain Limit 2, then Standard; Low only when power-constrained.
diagnosticPurpose: Repeat CP135 with common random numbers after changing only mainline Armor TL6-TL9 and TL6 A_b1 Crystalline Armor. Measure whether steady Armor regeneration permits persistent offensive progress while preserving the regenerative-vs-passive branch distinction, with all Shield/DamCon/weapon/PDS/reference-build rules held.
damageControlDoctrine: HullOnlyWhenDamaged; one attempt/turn; 1 TP + 1 kit per attempt; success queues to next Turn Refresh; component repair off; Armor regeneration uses remaining TP.
comparisonBaseline: Accepted CP135 substantive 1,960,000-engagement diagnostic; same context/variant identities and master seed retained.
